slots.theme: o'tgan zamon: ota-bobolarimiz hayoti, eski Toshkent, SSSR davri, «bizning vaqtimizda» — hozirgi bilan hazil taqqoslash
hozirgi o'zbekchilik: internet, telefon, o'yinlar, ish, pul, tirbandlik — hazil va qiziq faktlar
kelajak: 2050-yil, koinot, sun'iy intellekt, robotlar, Marsdagi o'zbek to'yi — fantastik hazil + haqiqiy ilmiy fakt
urf-odatlar: to'y, mehmondorchilik, sovchilik, hayit, qo'shnichilik — mehr va hazil bilan, masxarasiz
odamlarda ko'p uchraydigan xatolar: kechiktirish, telefon, pul, sog'liq, o'qish — hazil + foydali xulosa (bugungi videolardek)

style.image_prefix: Bright cheerful hand-drawn cartoon illustration, clean bold ink outlines, vivid saturated warm colors, high-key soft lighting, light airy palette (no dark or gloomy scenes unless the story needs night), vertical 9:16 composition, no text, no letters, no logos.
style.character_prefix: Same art style. Single character only, full or half body, expressive pose, isolated on a plain flat pure white background, no shadow, no scenery, no text.
style.prop_prefix: Same art style. Single object only, isolated on a plain flat pure white background, no shadow, no text.

image_fallback: none — rasm faqat Google Flow (egasi Higgsfield'ni rad etdi). Noutbuk o'chiq bo'lsa to'xtab egasiga xabar ber.

video_rules.multi_character: kamida 2-3 personaj gapiradi (masalan dadasi: «Ex bolam, mening vaqtimda...»), har biri boshqa ElevenLabs ovozida
video_rules.vo_chunks: ovoz bo'laklari uzunroq (1-3 to'liq gap), mayda-mayda emas
video_rules.style_ref: bitta qahramonning kuni: holat ko'rsatkichi (SABR/ENERGIYA %), soat, tez almashadigan sahnalar, oxirida hisob-kitob varag'i; ammo boshqa brend logotiplarini ishlatmang
video_rules.look: yorqin, ochiq rangli dizayn; qorong'i sahnalar faqat syujet talab qilsa
video_rules.png_characters: har videoda 3-6 marta PNG personaj/buyum stikeri (oq konturli) chetdan yoki pastdan chiqib keladi, gapirganda qimirlaydi (`char`/`prop` elementlari). Personajlarni oq fonda alohida generatsiya qiling: img/c_<nom>.jpg
video_rules.bubbles: dialoglarda `bubble` (gapiruvchi nomi + so'zlar ovozga qarab yonadi), muhim so'zlar rangli
video_rules.stickers: stikerlar xilma-xil: pill, label, sticky, clock, card, note, checklist, emoji-buyumlar; katta qizil `stamp`/`big` har videoda ko'pi bilan 1 marta
video_rules.no_repeat_motifs: bir xil raqam/motivni videodan-videoga takrorlamang (masalan '47' endi ishlatilmaydi)
video_rules.caption: caption qisqa: 1 ilmoq jumla + 1 savol + 6-8 heshteg; butun mavzuni yozib tashlamang
video_rules.own_design: Reference videolarni NUSXALAMANG — ulardan faqat g'oya oling (PNG stikerlar, pufakchalar). Har video mavzusiga mos O'Z dizayni: masalan koinot mavzusi — bola PNG holida koinotda suzib yuradi, o'zga sayyoraliklar bilan; o'yin mavzusi — piksel shrift va o'yin interfeysi; o'tmish — eski fotosurat/qog'oz uslubi.
video_rules.theme_each_video: har videoda `theme` boshqacha: shrift (bangers/luckiest/pixel/orbitron/lobster/fredoka/russo/rubikmono/marker/inter), rang palitrasi (accent, accent2), pufakcha ranglari, fon turi (rasm/space/blueprint), personaj harakati (float/fly/bounce/shake/spin/idle). Oldingi videodagi kombinatsiyani takrorlamang — topics_log.md ga yozing.
video_rules.extra_images: mavzuga kerakli qo'shimcha rasmlarni (PNG personajlar, o'zga sayyoralik, buyumlar, fonlar) Google Flow'da o'zing yarat
